---
title: Controls and preview links set to auto
format: revealjs
controls: auto
previewLinks: auto
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'controls: false,'
          - "'controlsAuto': true,"
          - 'previewLinks: false,'
          - "'previewLinksAuto': true,"
        -
          - 'controls: auto,'
          - 'previewLinks: auto,'
---

## Slide

`auto` is not a valid reveal.js value: Quarto passes `false` to reveal.js and enables its own automatic behavior instead.
